# Reawakening — New Cube Recipes (S14 port)

Derived from a field-level diff of `data/global/excel/CubeMain.txt` between the S14
vanilla baseline (commit `6206a2c`) and the Reawakening merge (`023404e` → HEAD).
**795 recipe rows were added, 0 vanilla S14 recipes removed.** Of the added rows,
~700 are enabled and ~95 are disabled (`enabled=0`) — disabled ones are marked
*([disabled])*. Raw listing: `tools/cube_diff_report.txt` (generated by `tools/diff_cube.py`).

The RA wiki (pd2reawakening.com) was unreachable at documentation time, so this
document is based purely on the repo data, which is authoritative for this port.

## 1. Awakening system (Vial of Awakening, `dvia`)

**Add awaken factor** (vial is returned/kept as factor, `useitem | dvia`):
- Weapon, Armor, Amulet, Ring, Quiver (`misl`), Unique charms — each: item + 1 Vial of Awakening

**Awaken an item** (item + 1 Vial of Awakening → item gains the listed property).
One recipe per item type per property (~140 recipes, all enabled):

- **Unique charms**: +1 all skills; hp% + flat hp; mana% + flat mana; all res + all stats; xp
- **Amulets**: all resist; max all resist; life on kill; mana on kill; all attributes; hp%+mana%; bone armor on cast; cyclone armor on cast; bone spear on cast; venom on kill; FoH on striking; lesser fade on kill; tornado on cast; holy nova on striking; poison nova on striking; +1 all skills
- **Rings**: life leech; mana leech; life on kill; mana on kill; fcr; ias; frw; ibc+fbr; cannot be frozen; dual life/mana on kill; dual leech; sanctuary aura; conviction aura; salvation aura; blade shield aura; +1 all skills
- **Gloves**: fcr+life on kill; fcr+mana on kill; ed+deadly strike; ed+itd; fire/ltng/cold/pois skill damage; lower resist on striking; cannot be frozen; phys/fire/ltng/cold/pois pierce; +1 all skills
- **Body armor**: hp%; mana%; life on kill; mana on kill; dual life/mana on kill; fcr; ias; frw; lvl 36 energy shield when equipped; +2 random class skills; fire/ltng/cold/pois mastery+pierce; +1 max curse; flat max+phys pierce
- **Helms**: damage reduced %; absorb fire/ltng/cold %; fcr+mana on kill; ias+frw; ibc+fbr; fhr+hp%+mana%; +1 all skill+fcr+ias; +2 random class skills; flat max+phys pierce; splash radius; fire/ltng/cold/pois mastery+pierce
- **Boots**: ibc+flat defense; fcr; ias; all res; max all res; life leech+life on kill; mana leech+mana on kill; ed+magic find; damage reduce %; cannot be frozen; dual life/mana leech; dual life/mana on kill; frw+fcr; frw+ias; frw+dual life/mana on kill; +1 all skills
- **Belts**: fcr; ias; frw; ibc+fbr; hp%+life on kill; mana%+mana on kill; all attributes; all res; 20 fcr; 20 ias; max all res; damage reduce %; flat damage+deadly; dual life/mana on kill; cannot be frozen; +1 all skills
- **Shields**: ibc+fbr; fhr+fbr; cyclone armor on cast/striking; bone armor on cast/striking; chilling armor when equipped; quickness when equipped; 20 fcr; max all res; redemption/holy freeze/vigor/defiance/fanaticism aura; +1 all skills
- **Weapons**: 20 fcr; enhanced damage; 40 ias; fire/ltng/cold/pois mastery; ed+life leech; crushing blow+ed; fcr+ias+fire/ltng/cold/pois pierce; 30 ias+ed; 50 flat max+5 phys pierce; +1 all skills
- **Quivers**: life leech; enhanced damage (×2 entries); frw; fire/ltng/cold/pois mastery; 10 ias; 20 ias; flat damage+deadly; phys pierce; might/conviction/fanaticism aura; +1 all skills

## 2. Corruption

- Gloves + 1 WSS → add corrupt factor (Replica Hand of Broc)
- Boots + 1 WSS → add corrupt factor (Replica Malthael's Shadow Steps)
- Hellfire Torch + 1 Tainted WSS (`cwss`) → add corrupt factor to torch

## 3. Lillith's Mirror (`llmr`) — duplicate an item

Item + Mirror → 2× the item (`useitem | useitem`):
- Unique weapon, armor, amulet, jewel; magic small/large/grand charm; magic skill grand charm
- *([disabled]) Unique ring*

## 4. Larzuk's Malus (`lmal`) — max sockets

Larzuk's Malus + unsocketed item → max sockets, for high-quality and normal:
Weapon / Helm / Shield / Chest (`tors`), both `hiq` and `nor` variants (8 recipes)

## 5. Class circlet crafts (~64 recipes)

Magic or rare circlet (ethereal and non-ethereal variants) + reagents → crafted
class circlet (`usetype,crf`):

- **Amazon**: jewel + r23 + perfect diamond → cast circ; **vial of awakening** + r23 + p diamond → ias circ
- **Paladin**: jewel + r23 + perfect skull → cast circ; vial + r23 + p skull → ias circ
- **Necromancer**: jewel + r23 + perfect amethyst → cast circ; vial + r23 + p amethyst → ias circ
- **Sorceress**: jewel + r23 + perfect topaz → cast circ; vial + r23 + p topaz → ias circ
- **Barbarian**: jewel + r23 + perfect sapphire → cast circ; vial + r23 + p sapphire → ias circ
- **Druid**: jewel + r23 + perfect emerald → cast circ; vial + r23 + p emerald → ias circ
- **Assassin**: jewel + r23 + perfect ruby → cast circ; vial + r23 + p ruby → ias circ

## 6. Divine Orb (`dvo`) — reroll values

- Unique armor/weapon (non-eth and eth, no-socket) → rerolled same item
- Set weapon/armor (no-socket) → rerolled
- Unique jewel → rerolled
- Unique grand charm → rerolled
- Unique/set ring, unique/set amulet, unique quiver → rerolled

## 7. Chaos Orb (`cho`) — reroll rares

Rare (eth and non-eth) weapon, armor, ring, amulet, quiver, jewel + 1 Chaos Orb → rerolled rare.

## 8. Ancient/Mythic Orb (`mfo`) — rare → unique

Enabled: rare (eth/non-eth) weapon, armor, ring, amulet, quiver → random unique of that base;
rare Hyperion → Unending Resolve. **Mythic Orb + 50 jewel fragments → random unique jewel.**
Many normal/magic-quality variants exist but are *([disabled])* (normal/magic → unique,
including the "item destroyed" downside outcomes).

## 9. Regal Orb (`rgo`) — rare → set

Rare (eth/non-eth) weapon, armor, amulet, ring → random set piece of that base.
Magic-quality variants *([disabled])*.

## 10. Orb of Unmaking (`oou`)

Amulet, ring, armor, weapon, unique charms, quiver + 1 Orb of Unmaking → "unmade"
item (`useitem` — strips/scours the item).

## 11. Tainted Jeweller's Orb (`tjo`) — socket manipulation

- Socketed magic / rare / crafted / unique / set item + 1 TJO → adds a "factor" (TJO kept)
- Socketed magic / rare / crafted / unique / set item + 1 TJO → **destroy sockets** (`uns`, contents lost)
- Socketed magic / rare / crafted / unique / set item + 1 TJO → **remove sockets** (`rem`, item kept)
- Normal/superior variants of all of the above exist but are *([disabled])*

## 12. Hatred / Terror Embers (`heo` / `teo`) — awakened skills on charms

Hellfire Torch **or** Annihilus + 1 ember → adds the awakened skill per class:

- **Hatred Ember**: ama → Awakened Multiple Shot; sor → Awakened Charged Bolt; nec → Awakened Teeth; pal → Awakened Concentration; bar → Awakened Concentrate; dru → Awakened Cyclone Armor; ass → Awakened Fade of Speed
- **Terror Ember**: ama → Awakened Cold Arrow; sor → Awakened Blizzard; nec → Awakened Bone Spear; pal → Awakened Blessed Hammer; bar → Awakened War Cry; dru → Awakened Tornado; ass → Awakened Mind Blast

## 14. Runes

- **Rune downgrading**: any rune El(1)…Zod(33) + 1 key → 1 of the previous rune (32 recipes, r02–r33)

## 15. Gems

- **Bulk flawless → perfect**: 6/9/12/…/48 flawless gems of one type + 1 key → 2–16 perfect gems
  (1 perfect per 3 flawless), for amethyst, ruby, sapphire, topaz, emerald, diamond, skull (105 recipes)

## 16. Stacking / exchange recipes

- 1 Ist + 1 perfect gem (amethyst/ruby/sapphire/topaz/emerald/diamond/skull) → 50 stacked perfect gems
- 1 Ist + 1 low rune (El…Sol, r01–r12) → 50 stacked copies of that rune
- 1 Vex + 50 jewel fragments + 1 Coin → 10 Vials of Awakening
- 1 Sur + 50 T2 sigils → 50 T1 sigils; 1 Sur + 50 T3 sigils → 50 T2 sigils
- *([disabled]) Lo/Sur + 50 jewels + coin → 10 Divine/Mythic orbs*
- *([disabled]) LPP/Coin exchanges (puzzle box, Vex, Mal, catalyst shards, Lillith's Mirror, Vial of Lightsong)*

## 17. Eternal Coin disenchanting (quality-based)

- **Unique-quality item + 1 key → 1 Eternal Coin (`ncoi`)** (`any,uni` + `key,qty=1`)
- **Set-quality item + 1 key → 1 Eternal Coin** (`any,set` + `key,qty=1`)
- **5 Eternal Coins → 1 Vial of Awakening (`dvia`)** (one `ncoi,qty=5` input)

The recipes match *item quality*, not item tables: any unique or set item qualifies,
including RA-added uniques, replicas, legacy items, unique jewels, all unique charms,
quivers, and unique maps / special (trophy/dev) unique items. Normal, magic, rare, or
crafted versions of a base that has a unique variant do **not** match. Ethereal,
socketed, corrupted, awakened, or mirrored items still disenchant.

Disenchanting destroys the item **and any socket contents** — it is irreversible.

*Status: statically validated (row format, duplicate, and reference checks); in-game
acceptance tests pending. See `docs/eternal_coin_disenchanting_plan.md`.*

## 18. Relics

**Relic of the Nephalem (`rotf`)** — 1 relic → random legacy item: 08 Shako, 08 Arkaine's,
Armageddon Slippers, King's Jewel of Blazing, Storm Circlet, 08 Vgaze, Siggard's Stealth,
Snatchii's Steelclash, Wiz Gloves, Occy SoJ, Bugged Windforce / Stormshield / Buriza-Do Kyanon /
Aquariu's Stormrider / Wartraveler, Ith Colossus Blade.

**Relic of the Void (`rotv`)** — 1 relic → random: Itheraels Path, Overlords Helm, Dark Abyss,
Aidans Scar, Hadriels Hand, Band of Skulls, Cage of the Unsullied, The Third Eye.

**Relic of the False Prophet (`rofp`)** — 1 relic → random replica item (~100 outcomes:
Replica Templar's Might, Tyrael's Might, Steel Carapace, Leviathan, … Replica Armageddon's Blade).

## 19. Endgame / portal access

- 10 Zod + 1 Coin → Vial of Lightsong
- 50 `dcbl` + 50 jewel fragments + 1 Coin → Pandemonium Talisman
- 50 WSS + 2 stacked high runes (r33g×2) → Rathma access (`rtma`)
- 4 superior-socket recipes: e.g. r07+r10 + perfect topaz + superior torso → socketed torso;
  r08+r11 + perfect amethyst + superior weapon; r08+r10 + perfect sapphire + superior helm;
  r07+r11 + perfect ruby + superior shield

## Disabled / test-only groups (not active in-game)

- Item dye (remove dye / red armor)
- Map drop-increase test recipes (map + perfect gem)
- Mythic-orb normal/magic → unique gamble outcomes (incl. item-destroyed results)
- Small/large charm + TES/CEH/BET/FED → Cain's Wisdom / Larzuk's Legacy
- "Randomise mods" dev recipes (Divine Orb + any item, `useitem,reg`)
